answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and draws a fresh task per epoch: forge a basalt wedge for the willow shop, filing heat log and willow receipt on file. Auditors replay the log against the basalt record; reuse or a missed delivery burns the bond. First task costs 45, k-th 45+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,041,000 plus 70,000 in bonds for a 40,000 pool. Two receipts on one forge log expose a rented-solver ring. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep the bond.
